problems.name: Permutation in String
problems.question: Given strings s1 and s2, return true if s2 contains a permutation of s1 as a contiguous substring.
problems.constraints: 1 <= s1.length, s2.length <= 10^4; s1 and s2 consist of lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: The substring "ba" is a permutation of "ab".
No substring has both a and b together.
The substring "dca" is a permutation of "adc".

problems.optimizedComplexity: Time O(n), Space O(1), using fixed 26-character count arrays.
